source_package_role: Private exact-source design baseline; ZIP CRC and all 15 internal manifest file size/hash checks passed, the deterministic rebuild matched, and the package SHA-256 is recorded. The public case study exposes outcomes and boundaries, not internal operating text.

public_policy_revision.status: current independent-local-operation, runtime-identity, canonical-entrypoint, and project-local-output language
computer_recognition_allowed_for: local logs, state, and export organization
computer_recognition_prohibited_for: control of another independently running copy

required_outcomes: each first-party project has a case-insensitively unique execution namespace
one stable unversioned project-qualified canonical entrypoint is recorded
version, build, and date labels stay in metadata and archive names rather than normal launch filenames
legacy launcher or backend names use a migration map or thin forwarding wrapper without duplicated business logic
canonical launch files are included in the immutable managed-file inventory for executable releases
project root resolves from the canonical launcher or script location rather than caller current working directory
runtime-owned configuration, logs, state, temp, caches, exports, diagnostics, reports, downloads, backups, and release evidence default beneath project root
same-volume project-local temporary writes are verified before atomic finalization where practical
external destinations are explicit, normalized, validated, displayed, and recorded
migration never silently moves or deletes existing external data
smoke tests launch from another working directory and verify project-local output containment

runtime_release_identity.software_trigger: released running software that may load credentials or perform authenticated/live startup
required_outcomes: running version/build agrees with package identity metadata
every package-managed immutable file is present and SHA-256 verified
same-version mixed or unsafe packages block authenticated/live startup
blocked mode retains local status, repair guidance, and redacted support evidence without silent rewrite
